title: Pullback preserves the specified compactification graph projection on sheaves
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:U\to X$ separated etale, $c=(i:U\to Z,p:Z\to X)$ a compactification, and $g:X'\to X$ arbitrary. Put $U'=X'\times_XU$, with $h:U'\to U$ and $f':U'\to X'$, and let $c'=(i':U'\to Z',p':Z'\to X')$ and $t:Z'\to Z$ be the pulled-back compactification. Write $E=f_!$, $E'=f'_!$, $H=h^*$, $G=g^*$, $P=p^*$, $P'=p'^*$, $T=t^*$, $J=i_!$, $J'=i'_!$. Let $\delta:EP\to J$ and $\delta':E'P'\to J'$ be the sheaf projections [lem-a2-compact-support-termwise-projection] of the actual graph maps [def-f7-etale-compactification-graph-map]. Let $\sigma:EG\simeq HE'$ be the inverse etale sum base-change map [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map], $\theta:GP'\simeq PT$ the inverse-image square comparison, and $j:HJ'\to JT$ the open-extension base-change comparison. Then $(\sigma P');(H\delta');j=(E\theta);(\delta T)$, with the displayed associators. This is an identity of ordinary-sheaf transformations over arbitrary schemes and coefficients, including empty fibers and the zero ring.

proof.text: First transpose the specified graph map back under p* ⊣ p_*; the triangle identities cancel the unit and counit inserted in its definition, giving exactly the original etale sum base-change comparison followed by the graph projection and graph composition comparison. In V=Z×_XU the section s=(i,id) of q:V→U is clopen: it is open because the other projection is etale and i is open, and closed because it is a section of the separated q. Base change gives V′ and its graph section s′, with graph and complementary open identified with their pullbacks. The graph projection q*→s_! is identity on the graph and zero on its complement, since it is the unit q*→s_*s*q* followed by the composition identity and the inverse clopen comparison s_!≅s_*.

proof.text: Restrict the pulled-back projection and the projection for V′ to this disjoint open cover. Both keep precisely the same section on the graph and vanish on the complement. Their equality follows from sheaf gluing on this disjoint cover; this argument is natural in the sheaf and does not use detection of derived morphisms by stalks.

proof.text: The sum exchange is the inverse left-adjoint comparison conjugate to inverse-image/direct-image exchange; the open-extension and graph composition comparisons use the same displayed adjunctions. Horizontal and vertical mate pasting identify the two pasted rectangles. Compose the preceding graph-projection identity with those comparisons to obtain exactly the displayed equation, including the specified direction of σ and j.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportGraphSheafProjection_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] [IsSeparated f]
    (c : Compactification f) (g : X' ⟶ X) :
    let c' := c.ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip
    let E := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance
    let H := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd g f)
    let E' := etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst g f) inferInstance
    let P := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
    let P' := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g
    let T := upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst c.g g)
    let δ := compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A f c (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c)
    let δ' := compactSupportGraphSheafProjection A (pullback.fst g f) c'
      (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A (pullback.fst g f) c')
    letI := isIso_etaleLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A g f
    let σ := (asIso (etaleLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A g f)).symm
    Functor.whiskerRight σ.hom P' ≫ (Functor.associator H E' P').hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft H δ' ≫
        openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (c.isPullback_i_ofIsPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip).toCommSq =
      (Functor.associator E (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g) P').hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft E
          (squareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
            (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c.g g).toCommSq).hom ≫
        (Functor.associator E P T).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight δ T
